channel.title: Cheaper by the Dozen 2
channel.desc: Tom Baker and wife Kate, hoping to bring their family together for a memorable summer holiday, take their twelve offspring to the picturesque Lake Winnetka. Their retreat soon becomes a place of cut-throat one-upmanship when they enter into a competition with the over-achieving members of a large family headed by Tom's long-time rival, Jimmy Murtaugh.
